# Theme

Emorie Beck, PhD, data viz [Custom Theme](https://emoriebeck.github.io/psc290-dataviz-WQ25/08-week8-workbook.html#custom-theme)

```{r}

my_theme = function(){
  theme_light(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
    , legend.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = rel(1.8))
    , legend.text = element_text(face = "plain", size = rel(1.8))
    , axis.text = element_text(face = "plain", size = rel(1.8), color = "black")
    , axis.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = rel(1.8))
    , plot.title = element_blank()
    , plot.subtitle = element_blank()
    , strip.text = element_text(face = "plain", size = rel(1.8), color = "black")
    , strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "gray70")
    , panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

```


# Centrality Measures

## Descriptives & Plots


```{r}
# Descriptives of networks 
avg.offdiag = function(mat) mean(mat[lower.tri(mat)])

summarize.pcor = function(data) {
  
  lapply(data, function(x) {
    tibble(x$condition,
      mean.true.pcor  = mean(sapply(x$true.pcor,  avg.offdiag)),
      mean.redun.pcor = mean(sapply(x$redun.pcor, avg.offdiag)),
      mean.random.pcor = mean(sapply(x$random.pcor, avg.offdiag)))}) |> 
    bind_rows()}

avg.pcor <- summarize.pcor(data)





avg.pcor |>  
  summarize(mean_true = mean(mean.true.pcor),
            mean_redun = mean(mean.redun.pcor),
            mean_random.pcor = mean(mean.random.pcor))



```


```{r}

dimnames(data[[1]]$"local.metrics") # To get correct names for local measures

dimnames(data[[1]]$"global.metrics") # To get correct names for global measures




new.data = lapply(X = data,
                     FUN = function(x) {
                     list(condition = x$condition, 
                          G_TNS = x$local.metrics[,"Target", "Closeness"],
                          G_RNS = x$local.metrics[,"Target.r", "Closeness w/o Clone"],
                          G_ANS = x$local.metrics.random[, "Target.r", "Closeness w/o Random"])})
# dimnames(data[[1]]$local.metrics)

tibble.data = lapply(X = new.data,
                     FUN = function(x){
                       tibble(
                         G_TNS = x$G_TNS,
                         G_RNS = x$G_RNS,
                         G_ANS = x$G_ANS) |> 
                         bind_cols(x$condition[rep(1, 500), ])}) |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = !c(mn.cor, nv, clone.loading),
               names_to = "Network",
               values_to = "Value") |>
  group_by(Network, mn.cor, nv, clone.loading) |> 
  summarize(Mean = mean(Value),
            SD = sd(Value),
            .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate_at(c("Network", "mn.cor"), factor) |> 
  mutate(clone.loading = factor(clone.loading,
                                levels = c(0.7, 0.9),
                                labels = c("Medium Redundancy",
                                           "High Redundancy")),
         nv = factor(nv, 
                     levels = c(10, 20),
                     labels = c("10 Node", "20 Node")),
         Network = factor(Network,
                          levels = c("G_TNS", "G_RNS", "G_ANS"),
                          ordered = TRUE))




pdf(file = "Target_Closeness.pdf",
     width = 12,
      height = 8)

# res = 500,
# units = "in"


dropleadingzero <- function(l){
  str_replace(sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(l)), '0(?=.)', '')
}

ggplot(data = tibble.data, mapping = aes(x = mn.cor, y = Mean,
                       shape = Network, color = Network,
                       group = Network)) + 
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  facet_grid(nv ~ clone.loading) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SD/sqrt(500),
                    ymax = Mean + SD/sqrt(500)),
                linewidth = .35,
                color = "black",
                width = .2) +
  labs(x = expression("Average Latent Variable Correlations" ~ (rho)),
       y = "Closeness") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Network",
                       labels = expression(G[T], G[R], G[A]),
                       values = c("#0072B2",
                                  "#D55E00",
                                  "#E69F00")) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Network",
                       labels = expression(G[T], G[R], G[A]),
                       values = c(15, 17, 16)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = dropleadingzero) +
  my_theme() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5))
dev.off()

 


```
